en: Theragāthā 2.29 Dukanipāta, Tatiyavagga (The Third Chapter) I am one who has crossed over the flood; I have reached the further shore. I have attained Nibbāna; I am now free from all bonds. I have abandoned all attachments; I am liberated in every way. I am one who has reached the goal; I am a sage who has done what was to be done. I am one who has laid down the burden; I am free from the yoke. I have destroyed the fetters of existence; I am no longer subject to rebirth. I have cut off craving at its root; I am like a tree whose roots are severed. I have extinguished the fires of passion, hatred, and delusion. I am cooled, peaceful, and serene. I am one who has reached the end of suffering; I am a victor in the battle against Māra. I am one who has attained the supreme security from bondage. I am a bhikkhu who has truly understood; I am one who has reached the final state. I am one who has transcended all states of being; I am one who has gone beyond all fear. I am one who has attained the deathless; I am one who has found the island of safety. I am one who has reached the city of peace; I am one who has entered the citadel of Nibbāna. I am one who has conquered all defilements; I am one who is victorious in every respect. I am one who has realized the truth; I am one who has seen the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the fruit of Arhatship; I am one who is worthy of offerings. I am one who has fulfilled the holy life; I am one who has lived the life of purity. I am one who has reached the ultimate goal; I am one who has attained the highest good. I am one who has crossed over the ocean of saṃsāra; I am one who has reached the dry land of liberation. I am one who has attained the state of an arahant; I am one who is free from all taints. I am one who has abandoned all clinging; I am one who is unattached. I am one who has attained the bliss of peace; I am one who is cool and tranquil. I am one who has reached the end of the journey; I am one who has completed the path. I am one who has attained the state of a Buddha’s disciple; I am one who has followed the Teacher’s instruction. I am one who has realized the Dhamma for myself; I am one who has attained the vision of the Truth. I am one who has attained the state of a stream-enterer, once-returner, non-returner, and arhat. I am one who has attained the four stages of enlightenment; I am one who has reached the pinnacle of the spiritual life. I am one who has attained the three knowledges; I am one who has realized the divine eye. I am one who has attained the six supernormal powers; I am one who has mastered the higher faculties. I am one who has attained the eight liberations; I am one who has realized the nine successive attainments. I am one who has attained the ten powers of a Buddha; I am one who has reached the perfection of wisdom. I am one who has attained the four bases of psychic power; I am one who has mastered the mind. I am one who has attained the five faculties; I am one who has developed the five powers. I am one who has attained the seven factors of enlightenment; I am one who has realized the path to peace. I am one who has attained the noble eightfold path; I am one who has walked the way of the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the state of a true brahmin; I am one who is pure in conduct. I am one who has attained the state of a true ascetic; I am one who has subdued the senses. I am one who has attained the state of a true monk; I am one who has renounced the world.

I am one who has attained the state of a true recluse; I am one who has abandoned all evil. I am one who has attained the state of a true sage; I am one who has realized the goal. I am one who has attained the state of a true saint; I am one who is worthy of veneration. I am one who has attained the state of a true hero; I am one who has conquered all enemies. I am one who has attained the state of a true victor; I am one who has triumphed over Māra. I am one who has attained the state of a true conqueror; I am one who has won the battle for liberation. I am one who has attained the state of a true leader; I am one who has guided others to safety. I am one who has attained the state of a true teacher; I am one who has shown the way to Nibbāna. I am one who has attained the state of a true guide; I am one who has led the caravan across the desert of saṃsāra. I am one who has attained the state of a true refuge; I am one who is the shelter for all beings. I am one who has attained the state of a true protector; I am one who guards the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the state of a true friend; I am one who is compassionate toward all. I am one who has attained the state of a true kinsman; I am one who is related to all through the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the state of a true relative; I am one who is bound by love for the Sangha. I am one who has attained the state of a true companion; I am one who walks the path with the wise. I am one who has attained the state of a true ally; I am one who supports the cause of righteousness. I am one who has attained the state of a true helper; I am one who assists those in need. I am one who has attained the state of a true benefactor; I am one who brings happiness to all. I am one who has attained the state of a true giver; I am one who bestows the gift of the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the state of a true donor; I am one who offers the alms of virtue. I am one who has attained the state of a true host; I am one who welcomes all guests. I am one who has attained the state of a true guest; I am one who visits the dwellings of the wise. I am one who has attained the state of a true visitor; I am one who frequents the assemblies of the righteous. I am one who has attained the state of a true traveler; I am one who journeys on the road of liberation. I am one who has attained the state of a true wanderer; I am one who roams the world without attachment. I am one who has attained the state of a true pilgrim; I am one who seeks the city of peace. I am one who has attained the state of a true seeker; I am one who searches for the truth. I am one who has attained the state of a true explorer; I am one who investigates the nature of reality. I am one who has attained the state of a true discoverer; I am one who finds the hidden treasure of the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the state of a true knower; I am one who understands the meaning of existence. I am one who has attained the state of a true seer; I am one who perceives the future. I am one who has attained the state of a true prophet; I am one who foretells the end of suffering. I am one who has attained the state of a true visionary; I am one who sees the light of wisdom. I am one who has attained the state of a true dreamer; I am one who dreams of the bliss of Nibbāna. I am one who has attained the state of a true poet; I am one who composes verses of praise for the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the state of a true singer; I am one who sings the song of liberation. I am one who has attained the state of a true dancer; I am one who dances in the joy of peace. I am one who has attained the state of a true musician; I am one who plays the lute of the Dhamma. I am one who has attained the state of a true painter; I am one who paints the portrait of the Buddha. I am one who has attained the state of a true sculptor; I am one who carves the image of virtue. I am one who has attained the state of a true architect; I am one who builds the temple of the Sangha. I am one who has attained the state of a true builder; I am one who constructs the bridge to the beyond. I am one who has attained the state of a true engineer; I am one who designs the path to enlightenment. I am one who has attained the state of a true craftsman; I am one who fashions the vessel of the Dhamma. I am one who

like lions in the mountain caves.”
The heroes who have conquered the battle,
having defeated Māra along with his host,
and the Teacher has been fully served by me.
The Dhamma and the Saṅgha have been honored;
and I too am gratified and joyful,
having seen my son free from the taints.
